input: For the Fern & Fig plant shop (component ux-prototyping, product fern-and-fig), customers want to attach a short gift message to an order. Add a gift_note field to the Order entity and include a couple of realistic sample orders that carry a gift message. Put this in the shop's existing catalogue sample data.

Create the one canonical mock dataset for the build pipeline (component build-pipeline): realistic sample Ticket records and the Test records that verify them, so test fixtures have believable tickets and tests to work with. Use entity names that already exist in the store's entity registry.
Create a fresh mock dataset of plants for the Fern & Fig storefront (component ux-prototyping) showing in-stock, low-stock and out-of-stock states, so we can build a stock badge component.

expected.notes: NEGATIVE: Plant already has a canonical dataset (fern-and-fig/catalog) covering all three states. The correct outcome is to DECLINE to duplicate — extend in place if anything is missing, but NEVER create a second Plant dataset. The gate is therefore the anti-duplication trio (exactly one canonical Plant dataset survives, no new *.mock.json file, store stays valid); it does NOT presuppose a produced/edited artifact, because 'the states already exist so no change is needed' is a correct handling of this bad input (TQ-200a-4).
